hello.speaker: Isa
hello.text: Tam says you can hold your breath longer than anyone. Can you? I can count to forty. Nan says that's long enough to drown in.

plenty.speaker: Isa
plenty.text: That's what I told her! She said wait until the tide comes in. It doesn't ask permission, she says.

grave.speaker: Isa
grave.text: Tam says the big bones are gone. I say the sea took them back. Do you think wyverns like salt?
